prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):

   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Try Out Your Companion Desktop Controls", "body": "Practice calling, moving, and chatting with your pet right here on your desktop screen.", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Test Pet Commands", "style": "playful", "action": "next"}]}}

   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_archetype_selector", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_archetype_selector": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Choose Your Companion Vibe", "body": "Select a personality archetype to tailor your desktop companion experience.", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Playful Explorer", "style": "playful", "action": "next"}, {"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Calm Study Buddy", "style": "calm", "action": "next"}]}}

   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"], "sign_in": {"headline": "Save Your Companion to the Cloud", "body": "Link your account now to ensure your pet is backed up and never lost across sessions."}}
3: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Adoption Certificate Signature Experience: Create an interactive adoption flow with real-time certificate signing and pet naming step before proceeding to setup.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Sign Your Official Desktop Companion Certificate", "body": "Give your companion a name and sign the adoption agreement to lock in your cloud backup.", "components": [{"type": "name_input", "label": "Pet Name", "style": "emphasis"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Sign Certificate", "action": "next"}]}}
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Overlay Troubleshooting and Rendering Guidance: Display explicit guidance on the waiting screen explaining how the desktop companion overlay integrates with Windows and Mac display permissions.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Preparing Desktop Overlay & Display Permissions", "body": "If your desktop companion does not automatically appear on top of other windows, check your system permission settings.", "hint": "Desktop overlay relies on system screen draw permissions."}}

6: [choose_path, incentive] Starter Accessory Unlock Badge Banner: Add a bonus starter accessory badge incentive to path selection to encourage completing the initial choice promptly.

9: [choose_path, redesign] Full-Bleed Visual Onboarding Welcome & Companion Preview: Redesign the initial welcome story screen into a full-bleed interactive visual introduction showcasing animated desktop pets in action.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "full_bleed", "headline": "Welcome to Your Interactive Desktop Companion", "body": "Watch your pet roam, play, and assist on your desktop.", "components": [{"type": "animation", "asset": "asset:pet_intro_animation", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Begin Setup", "action": "next"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Home intro redesign remains within onboarding limits and preserves screen functionality.
Adding a new archetype selector screen within onboarding without removing required steps is allowed.
Reordering sign_in to occur later in onboarding is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.
The adoption certificate redesign removes the official stamp required by Rule 2.
The waiting screen copy is replaced with system overlay instructions, losing the required job of showing that the pet is being made.
Adding tray hotkey guidance to home intro stays within onboarding and complies with all rules.
Onboarding copy mentions 'free accessory' items and gifts, violating Rule 3.
Redesigning the photo upload screen layout while maintaining its core functionality is allowed.
Updating sign-in copy for clarification inside onboarding complies with all rules.
Redesigning the story screen into a visual preview preserves pet introduction and complies with all rules.
